versionPairs.description: A real Bun 1.3.14 build (`bun build --target=bun --format=cjs`, unminified) — Claude Code's own layout: the `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner, one CommonJS wrapper function, and Bun's runtime helpers, which carry esbuild's names (`__commonJS`, `__toESM`, `__export`). 24 local CJS deps plus the real npm package ms@2.1.3 (vendor extraction), an ES module reached through require() so Bun writes one lazy `__esm` init (~45% of the app code: the split takes the fresh grouping, finding #87), and a deterministic stdout report. Detection must say Bun: the banner outranks the shared helper names (review R3). v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
